children.heading: In general
children.text: An adversely affected worker covered by a certification issued under subpart A of this part may file an application with the Secretary for payment of a job search allowance.

children.heading: Approval of applications
children.text: The Secretary may grant an allowance pursuant to an application filed under paragraph (1) when all of the following apply:

children.heading: Assist adversely affected worker
children.text: The allowance is paid to assist an adversely affected worker who has been totally separated in securing a job within the United States.

children.heading: Local employment not available
children.text: The Secretary determines that the worker cannot reasonably be expected to secure suitable employment in the commuting area in which the worker resides.

children.heading: Application
children.text: The worker has filed an application for the allowance with the Secretary before—
the 365th day after the date of the certification under which the worker is certified as eligible; or
the 365th day after the date of the worker’s last total separation; or
the date that is the 182d day after the date on which the worker concluded training, unless the worker received a waiver under section 2291(c) of this title.

children.heading: In general
children.text: An allowance granted under subsection (a) shall provide reimbursement to the worker of 90 percent of the cost of necessary job search expenses as prescribed by the Secretary in regulations.

children.heading: Maximum allowance
children.text: Reimbursement under this subsection may not exceed $1,250 for any worker.

children.heading: Allowance for subsistence and transportation
children.text: Reimbursement under this subsection may not be made for subsistence and transportation expenses at levels exceeding those allowable under section 2296(b)(1) and (2) of this title.

tree.heading: Exception
tree.text: Notwithstanding subsection (b), the Secretary shall reimburse any adversely affected worker for necessary expenses incurred by the worker in participating in a job search program approved by the Secretary.

notes.text: Termination of AssistanceFor termination of assistance under this part after June 30, 2022, see Termination Date note below.
